backlog.acceptance: All VB6 forms are present in the C# application with equivalent controls. / Event handlers in VB6 are correctly mapped to C# event handlers.
All ActiveX components are replaced with equivalent C# libraries or controls. / OCX dependencies are removed and replaced with C# implementations.
All business logic from VB6 is implemented in C#. / Unit tests confirm that C# logic produces the same results as VB6 logic.
Database connections in C# are equivalent to those in VB6. / Data retrieval and manipulation are functionally identical.
User login functionality is present and operational in C#. / Authentication logic matches VB6 implementation.
Reports generated in C# match those from VB6 in format and content. / All report generation logic is implemented in C#.
Interest calculations in C# produce the same results as VB6. / All calculation logic is verified with unit tests.
Account creation, modification, and closure are functional in C#. / All account management workflows are preserved.
All operations complete within 2 seconds under normal load. / Performance tests show no degradation compared to VB6.
Security audit finds no critical vulnerabilities. / All data is encrypted in transit and at rest.
